angular-magnification.name: Angular Magnification Calculator (M = N/f)
angular-magnification.intro: Compute angular magnification from the near-point distance N (about 25 cm) and the focal length f of a simple magnifier. For estimating the magnifying power of loupes and magnifier arrays.

brewster-angle.name: Brewster's Angle Calculator
brewster-angle.intro: Find the incidence angle at which reflected light is completely polarized, θ = arctan(n₂/n₁). Useful for optical coatings, polarizers and glare reduction.

combined-lens-focal.name: Combined Lens Focal Length Calculator
combined-lens-focal.intro: Get the equivalent focal length of two cemented thin lenses from 1/f = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂. For combining and converting focal lengths in multi-element optical design.

doppler-optical.name: Optical Doppler Shift Calculator (f′ = f·(1 + v/c))
doppler-optical.intro: Compute the observed frequency from source frequency, relative velocity and the speed of light, using the non-relativistic approximation.

focal-length-mirror.name: Spherical Mirror Focal Length Calculator (f = R/2)
focal-length-mirror.intro: Derive the focal length of a concave or convex mirror from its radius of curvature using f = R/2. For geometrical optics, telescopes and reflector design.

fresnel-reflectance.name: Fresnel Reflectance Calculator
fresnel-reflectance.intro: Compute the fraction of energy reflected at normal incidence from the refractive indices of two media. For anti-reflection coatings, windows and fiber end-face loss estimates.

magnification-optics.name: Optical (Transverse) Magnification Calculator
magnification-optics.intro: Compute transverse magnification m = −dᵢ/dₒ, where the minus sign denotes an inverted image. For geometrical optics imaging, microscopes and projection systems.

malus-law.name: Malus's Law Calculator (I = I₀·cos²θ)
malus-law.intro: Compute transmitted intensity from linearly polarized incident intensity I₀ and the analyzer angle θ. For polarizers, LCDs and optics lab analysis.

mirror-equation.name: Spherical Mirror Equation Calculator
mirror-equation.intro: Enter focal length and object distance to get image distance from 1/f = 1/dₒ + 1/dᵢ, plus orientation, real/virtual and size. For school physics and imaging practice.

optical-power-diopter.name: Optical Power Calculator (P = 1/f)
optical-power-diopter.intro: Convert focal length in metres to optical power in diopters using P = 1/f. For optometry, eyeglass prescription and unified optical system power.

prism-deviation.name: Prism Deviation Angle Calculator (δ ≈ (n − 1)·A)
prism-deviation.intro: Compute the deviation angle from prism refractive index n and apex angle A under the small-angle approximation. For dispersing prisms and beam-steering elements.

rayleigh-criterion.name: Rayleigh Resolution Limit Calculator
rayleigh-criterion.intro: Find the minimum resolvable angle for circular-aperture diffraction, θ = 1.22λ/D. For evaluating the resolution limit of telescopes, microscopes and camera lenses.

refractive-index-speed.name: Refractive Index from Light Speed Calculator
refractive-index-speed.intro: Compute the refractive index of a medium from the speed of light in it, n = c/v.

resolving-power.name: Resolving Power Calculator (R = D/(1.22·λ))
resolving-power.intro: Compute resolving power and limiting resolution angle from circular aperture diameter D and wavelength λ in nanometres. For telescopes, microscopes and camera resolution.

separated-lenses-focal.name: Separated Lenses Focal Length Calculator (1/F = 1/f₁ + 1/f₂ − d/(f₁f₂))
separated-lenses-focal.intro: Compute the equivalent focal length of two thin lenses with separation d. For compound lenses and telescope eyepiece group design.

single-slit-diffraction.name: Single-Slit Diffraction Minima Calculator
single-slit-diffraction.intro: Find the first dark-fringe angle of Fraunhofer single-slit diffraction from a·sinθ = λ. For physics experiments, optical measurement and quantitative diffraction analysis.

snells-law.name: Snell's Law Refraction Calculator
snells-law.intro: Compute the refraction angle from incidence angle and the two refractive indices using n₁sinθ₁ = n₂sinθ₂, and detect total internal reflection. For geometrical optics and fiber transmission.

thin-film-max.name: Thin-Film Constructive Interference Calculator (2nt = mλ)
thin-film-max.intro: Compute the wavelength that interferes constructively at normal incidence from film index n, thickness t in nanometres and order m. For thin-film optics and reflection enhancement.

thin-film-min.name: Thin-Film Destructive Interference Calculator (2nt = (m+½)λ)
thin-film-min.intro: Compute the wavelength that interferes destructively at normal incidence from film index n, thickness t in nanometres and order m. For coating and anti-reflection design.

thin-lens-equation.name: Thin Lens Equation Calculator
thin-lens-equation.intro: Get image distance from object distance and focal length using 1/f = 1/dₒ + 1/dᵢ, plus upright/inverted and real/virtual. For geometrical optics exercises and lens design.

young-fringe.name: Young's Double-Slit Fringe Spacing Calculator (Δy = λL/d)
young-fringe.intro: Compute the spacing between adjacent bright (or dark) fringes from wavelength λ in nanometres, screen distance L in metres and slit separation d in millimetres. For physics labs.
